overview.answer: In January 2026, 28% of connections were cross-sector links. By October 2026 it is 45%. Connections between “Community and VCS” and “Council and statutory” grew from 3 to 14. In March 2026, 11 organisations had no connection and the map was in 14 separate pieces. Carrfield Volunteer Centre is the only thing holding 30 organisations to the rest. Carrfield Volunteer Centre and Carrfield Academy are in 30% of all connections.
overview.evidence: 11 of 40 connections then, 79 of 176 now. Cross-sector links are where joined-up working shows. In January 2026, all 3 ran through Carrfield Neighbourhood Co-ordinator. By October 2026: every one is connected, and the map is one piece. Take it out and Carrfield Knit and Natter, Carrfield Chess Club, Westgate Bowls Club and 27 more are cut off. The five best connected are in 47%.
